# Jarvis AI Desktop Agent

> Autonomous open-source AI desktop agent for Linux with multi-LLM support, desktop control via VNC, WhatsApp and Exchange email integration, and an extensible skill system.

## Overview

Jarvis is a self-hosted AI agent that runs on any Linux server. It provides a full desktop environment accessible via web browser, controlled by LLMs like Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, or local models via Ollama. Built with Python/FastAPI backend and vanilla JavaScript frontend.

## Key Features

- **Desktop Control**: Full Linux desktop via Xvfb/VNC, controlled by the AI agent in real-time
- **Multi-LLM Support**: Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenRouter (300+ models), any OpenAI-compatible API, local models via Ollama/LM Studio
- **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Main agent can spawn autonomous sub-agents for parallel task execution
- **RAG Knowledge Base**: Document search (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Excel, PPTX) with TF-IDF and ChromaDB vector database (automatic scaling with sentence-transformer embeddings)
- **MCP Integration**: Model Context Protocol support for external tool servers via stdio, Streamable HTTP or SSE. Third-party servers can run in a namespace sandbox with no access to the service directory or its credentials; access for network users is released per server
- **Exchange Email Rules**: Each user connects their own mailbox (EWS, IMAP/SMTP fallback) and writes their own rules in plain words; the model chooses the action (reply, draft, move, forward, delete). Per-rule tool scopes, always unprivileged, incoming mail text treated as information rather than instruction
- **Outlook Add-in**: The email area as an Outlook task pane – process the selected message with a rule, or generate a reply preview that is only sent on demand (the suggestion run has no tools). Passwordless sign-in via the Exchange identity token after first use
- **Read-only SAP Analyses**: 24 management analyses in six categories (P&L, balance sheet, working capital, aging, backlog, inventory, IFRS 8/9, consolidation, segregation of duties, VAT/Intrastat, ESG). Read-only is enforced: OData GET only, SQL SELECT only, RFC whitelist. Includes BI connection details and an AI-free query console
- **Knowledge Mirroring Between Sites**: One instance shares a knowledge folder, another pulls it one-way – incremental via SHA-256 manifest, pinned to the certificate confirmed at setup, mirror write-protected locally
- **Specialised Role Agents**: Named roles with their own system prompt, tool subset, LLM profile and thinking depth; the main agent delegates a subtask and waits for the result. A role can only narrow permissions, never widen them
- **Charts & Diagrams**: Interactive charts rendered in the chat from CSV/Excel files (grouping, sorting, European number formats, PNG export); validation happens before drawing so the model can correct itself. Mermaid diagrams for flows and structures
- **WhatsApp Integration**: Bidirectional messaging via Baileys, voice transcription with faster-whisper
- **OpenClaw Skill Marketplace**: Import community skills from ClawHub, auto-convert to native Jarvis tools
- **Face Recognition**: Real-time face detection and recognition using dlib/face_recognition with configurable actions
- **Browser Automation**: CDP-based browser control with xdotool fallback
- **Telemetry & Tracing**: Built-in OpenTelemetry tracing for agent runs, tool calls, and LLM interactions
- **Auto-Learning**: Automatically saves successful strategies after trial-and-error, learns user preferences from corrections
- **Custom Instructions**: User-defined Markdown files loaded into every conversation as system prompt extensions, editable via web UI

## Tech Stack

- Backend: Python 3.13, FastAPI, uvicorn, HTTPS
- Frontend: Vanilla JavaScript, Dark Glassmorphism Theme, WebSocket
- Desktop: Xvfb, Cinnamon/Openbox, x11vnc, noVNC
- Database: ChromaDB (vector), JSON (memory/settings)
- WhatsApp: Node.js, Baileys v7, faster-whisper

## Installation

Docker:
```
docker pull ghcr.io/dev-core-busy/jarvis:master
```

Install script (Debian/Ubuntu/Fedora/Arch):
```
curl -fsSL https://jarvis-ai.info/install.sh | bash
```

Updates: Re-run the same install script – it auto-detects existing installations.
